brand_presence: Small purple logo top right on a few inner slides (5-7, 9) but not on the cover or slides 2-4 and 8, large logo with credentials and website on the last slide
caption_summary: Short two-sentence caption with the keyword CTA up front ('הגיבו מוצץ'), then a medical disclaimer line; no hashtags
what_makes_it_work: The cover names a narrow, searchable problem plus 'the mistake parents make' and the label 'part A' promises more to come. Yet the keyword offer only appears on slide 7 of 10 and the post got 86 likes and 147 comments.
lumebook_takeaway: A series label like 'part A' on a narrow-problem cover gives people a reason to follow for the next one.
